# Desk

> Open-source Java workbench with a Rust TUI editor. Created by Ajay Tainwala.

Site: https://desk.ajaytainwala.dev/
Repository: https://github.com/ajaytainwala-dev/desk
Releases: https://github.com/ajaytainwala-dev/desk/releases/latest
License: MIT

## What is Desk?

Desk is a lightweight, cross-platform developer toolkit for Java. It ships:

- A Rust terminal UI (TUI) editor built with Ratatui (launch with `desk`)
- CLI commands: `desk fmt`, `desk check`, `desk compile`, `desk run`, `desk edit`, `desk help`, `desk version`
- Windows GUI installer, portable zips, and CLI setup scripts for macOS/Linux

Desk is designed for developers who want format / diagnose / edit / run loops without a heavy IDE.

## How to install Desk

- Website downloads: https://desk.ajaytainwala.dev/#downloads
- Windows PowerShell: `irm https://github.com/ajaytainwala-dev/desk/releases/latest/download/desk-cli-setup-windows.ps1 | iex`
- macOS / Linux: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/ajaytainwala-dev/desk/releases/latest/download/desk-cli-setup.sh | bash`
